This program keeps all work-based learning records in a folder you choose: on this computer or on your school's network drive. Nothing is sent to the internet.

Import student submissions by hand

  1. In Outlook (or your email), select the students' emails and save the attachments into the Inbox folder inside your data folder.
  2. Click Check Inbox folder. Imported files move to Inbox\Imported.

Import class list

A CSV file (save from Excel as CSV) with columns:
StudentID, FirstName, LastName, Program, Employer, JobTitle, WorkSupervisor, WorkSupervisorContact, StartDate, GoalHours
Only StudentID, FirstName and LastName are required. Existing students are updated.

Email connection

Lets the Check email button pull student submissions straight from your school inbox (read-only). Your district IT does a one-time setup and gives you a client ID: send them the email setup guide.

Backups

Your data folder holds the only copy of these records. Back it up to a USB drive or district network drive at least weekly.

The program also saves a daily snapshot inside your data folder (backups), but that won't help if this computer is lost.
